title: RTEM evapotranspiration partitioning and grouped GAM analysis: research software
description: Research software for evapotranspiration partitioning and environmental analysis in the Three-River Headwater Region, Tibetan Plateau. The release provides 21 Python scripts implementing SFE ET and VPD equations, initial uWUE/WUEt labels, the manuscript RTEM random forest, grouped PCA/GAM analysis, final-product evaluation, and manuscript and supporting-figure generation. The RF uses 11 predictors, 300 trees, square-root feature sampling, minimum leaf size 3, seed 42, and the 85th percentile of individual-tree WUEt predictions. GAM uses training-only standardization and within-group PCA retaining at least 95% variance, an 80:20 split with seed 42, and drop-group explained-deviance importance. Small synthetic-data tests compared core calculations with the original implementations; saved-model regression checks preserve the current manuscript metrics. The data archives are distributed separately. The original complete experiment-generation/plotting scripts for the Figure 6 parameter-sensitivity results, and the original Figure 3 point-pair plotting table/project, have not been located. The README describes these scope limitations. The associated manuscript is entitled “Evapotranspiration partitioning with machine learning and controls on vegetation transpiration in the Three-River Headwater Region”.
